rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a group or fleet of vehicles.

example.english: This company has a fleet that specializes in delivering goods to customers.
example.traditional: 呢間公司有一支車隊，專門幫客人送貨。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 zi1 ce1 deoi2 zyun1 mun4 bong1 haak3 jan4 sung3 fo3

rows.note: Use this for a fleet of warships or a country's naval force, including any group of military vessels.

example.english: The enemy country's fleet has entered our territorial waters.
example.traditional: 敵國艦隊已經駛入我哋嘅領海。
example.jyutping: dik6 gwok3 laam6 deoi2 ji5 ging1 sai2 jap6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 ling5 hoi2

rows.note: Use this for a group of civilian vessels rather than vehicles or warships.

example.english: A fleet of fishing boats went out to sea together.
example.traditional: 一隊漁船組成船隊，一齊出海捕魚。
example.jyutping: jat1 deoi6 jyu4 syun4 zou2 sing4 syun4 deoi2 jat1 cai4 ceot1 hoi2 bou6 jyu4
